Treatment summary
Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting pain and restricted motion in the right
shoulder. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms, and the force of the crash fits the type of
soft tissue damage found on examination. Imaging and physical findings clearly confirm the shoulder injury. No prior
injury to this body region is known from the patient's history. Over five visits, treatment followed a standard course
that included rest, a structured range-of-motion program, and anti-inflammatory medication. Symptoms improevd
steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accrodingly as function returned. At the most recent visit the patient had
regained most of the shoulder's range of motion with only mild residual discomfort on overhead activity. Billed
services correspond to the visits performed, with no duplicated or repeated charges. Continued home exercises and
a follow-up as needed were recommended.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
